title: Of All Things, I Became a Crow
altTitles: After All, I Became a Crow
I Ended Up Becoming a Crow
I Have Turned Into a Crow of All Things
よりによってカラスになってしまった
De todas as coisas, eu virei um corvo
ทำไมฉันต้องกลายเป็นอีกา
description: After dying in an accident, a woman is reincarnated inside an otome game as a crow rather than a human character. While searching for someone who can protect and raise her, she finds the wounded Crown Prince Kamut and helps him survive. He names her Reinel and takes her into the imperial palace, where her peaceful life as a beloved pet becomes entangled in royal conflicts, romance, and a mysterious transformation.
author: Sylvester
